welcome.title: Welcome to Meetily
welcome.description: Record. Transcribe. Summarize. All on your device.
welcome.featurePrivate: Your data never leaves your device

setup.title: Setup Overview
setup.description: Meetily requires that you download the Transcription & Summarization AI models for the software to work.
setup.externalProvidersTip: You can also select external AI providers like OpenAI, Claude, or Ollama for summary generation in settings.

download.title: Getting things ready
download.description: You can start using Meetily after downloading the Transcription Engine.
download.continueWhileFinishing: You can continue while this finishes
download.continuesInBackground: Download will continue in the background.
download.checkConnection: Please check your connection and try again.
download.summaryNotReady: Summary model recommendation is not ready yet
download.retryBeforeContinuing: Please retry the download before continuing.
download.backgroundTitle: Downloads will continue in the background
download.backgroundDescription: You can start using the app. Recording will be available once speech recognition is ready.

permissions.title: Grant Permissions
permissions.description: Meetily needs access to your microphone and system audio to record meetings
permissions.microphoneDescription: Required to capture your voice during meetings
permissions.systemAudioDescription: Click Enable to grant Audio Capture permission
permissions.microphoneSettingsAlert: Please enable microphone access in System Preferences > Security & Privacy > Microphone
permissions.systemAudioSettingsAlert: Please enable Audio Capture in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Audio Capture
permissions.warning: Recording won't work without permissions. You can grant them later in settings.
permissions.denied: Access Denied - Please grant in System Settings
